snp3.8:1.1: NIṬṬHITAṂ. Sallasutta. Animittam anaññātaṃ maccānaṃ idha jīvitaṃ kasirañ ca parittañ ca, tañ ca dukkhena saññutaṃ. || ||
snp3.8:2.1: Na hi so upakkamo atthi, yena jātā na miyyare, jaram pi patvā maraṇaṃ, evaṃdhammā hi pāṇino. || ||
snp3.8:3.1: Phalānam iva pakkānaṃ pāto papatanā bhayaṃ, evaṃ jātānaṃ maccānaṃ niccaṃ maraṇato bhayaṃ. || ||
snp3.8:4.1: Yathā pi kumbhakārassa katā mattikabhājanā sabbe bhedanapariyantā, evam maccāna jīvitaṃ. || ||
snp3.8:5.1: Daharā ca mahantā ca ye bālā ye ca paṇḍitā sabbe maccuvasaṃ yanti, sabbe maccuparāyanā. || ||
snp3.8:6.1: Tesaṃ maccuparetānaṃ gacchataṃ paralokato na pitā tāyate puttaṃ ñātī vā pana ñātake. || ||
snp3.8:7.1: Pekkhataṃ yeva ñātīnaṃ passa lālapataṃ puthu ekameko va maccānaṃ go vajjho viya niyyati. || ||
snp3.8:8.1: Evam abbhāhato loko maccunā ca jarāya ca, -- tasmā dhīrā na socanti viditvā lokapariyāyaṃ. || ||
snp3.8:9.1: Yassa maggaṃ na jānāsi āgatassa gatassa vā, ubho ante asampassaṃ niratthaṃ paridevasi. || ||
snp3.8:10.1: Paridevayamāno ce kañcid atthaṃ udabbahe sammūḷho hiṃsam attānaṃ, kayira c' enaṃ vicakkhaṇo. || ||
snp3.8:11.1: Na hi raṇṇena sokena santiṃ pappoti cetaso, bhiyy' ass' uppajjate dukkhaṃ, sarīraṃ upahaññati, || ||
snp3.8:12.1: kiso vivaṇṇo bhavati hiṃsam attānam attanā: na tena petā pālenti, niratthā paridevanā. || ||
snp3.8:13.1: Sokam appajahaṃ jantu bhiyyo dukkhaṃ nigacchati, anutthuṇanto kālakataṃ sokassa vasam anvagū. || ||
snp3.8:14.1: Aññe pi passa gamine yathākammūpage nare maccuno vasam āgamma phandante v' idha pāṇine. || ||
snp3.8:15.1: Yena yena hi maññanti, tato taṃ hoti aññathā, -- etādiso vinābhāvo, passa lokassa pariyāyaṃ: || ||
snp3.8:16.1: api ce vassasataṃ jīve bhiyyo vā pana mānavo, ñātisaṃghā vinā hoti, jahāti idha jīvitaṃ. || ||
snp3.8:17.1: Tasmā arahato sutvā vineyya paridevitaṃ petaṃ kālakataṃ disvā ‘na so labbhā mayā' iti. || ||
snp3.8:18.1: Yathā saraṇam ādittaṃ vārinā parinibbaye, evam pi dhīro sappañño paṇḍito kusalo naro khippam uppatitaṃ sokaṃ vāto tūlaṃ va dhaṃsaye || ||
snp3.8:19.1: paridevaṃ pajappañ ca domanassañ ca attano: attano sukham esāno abbahe sallam attano. || ||
snp3.8:20.1: Abbūḷhasallo asito santiṃ pappuyya cetaso, sabbasokaṃ atikkanto asoko hoti nibbuto ti || || SALLASUTTAṂ NIṬṬHITAṂ.
